law.admission_law_summary: rows failing the dataset's own closure identities (mass_additivity tol 0.02, pcsa_closure tol 0.02, blanks) quarantine whole, visibly; guimaraes M. mulatta is n=1 (specimen 127, KU Leuven)
law.substitution_law_summary: substitutions lawful ONLY for ABSENT rows; quarantined rows stay NAMED GAPS; a homolog number would be a silent fill; any filled quarantined row is a violation
law.homolog_route: CLOSED BY LAW - Myatt et al. 2011 (great apes) named as still-future for every row; never consumed
law.second_source_criteria: published peer-reviewed; Macaca-genus muscle architecture BY DISSECTION; per-muscle PCSA published or derivable under the closure laws; n>1 specimens; candidate rows pass mass_additivity 0.02 / pcsa_closure 0.02 / no blanks; explicit substitution record

search_conclusion: no published macaque (Macaca sp.) architecture study with per-muscle PCSA by dissection and n>1 exists for RF, SAR, AB, BFS, or TP; the quarantined Guimaraes rows are the only published macaque PCSA for these muscles
